seo.description: From financial brand guidelines to a tested vanilla UI library: explore the design and engineering of a Guatemalan investment portal.

hero.title: Pdei+: an investment portal, from brand guidelines to a shippable UI library
hero.lead: A coherent digital experience for investing in funds, shaped from the visual system through an interactive prototype and a reusable front-end library.
hero.note: Independent case study · Product design & front-end
hero.alt: Annotated investment dashboard mockup with portfolio chart and design tokens

challenge.title: Make a complex financial journey feel clear and dependable.
challenge.body: The portal supports fund investment, identity onboarding, two-factor authentication, beneficiaries and signatories, deposits, and redemptions. The work translates detailed product rules into a consistent interface and reusable components.

decisions.title: Choices that make the interface easier to build and use

items.title: Vanilla CSS & JavaScript
items.text: Fits a PHP and Livewire backend without coupling the library to a framework.

items.title: Tokens as the source of truth
items.text: Shared variables keep colors, spacing and states consistent across screens.

items.title: Clear design authority
items.text: Componentes governs visual patterns; Web Mock captures interaction behavior.

items.title: Name the financial action accurately
items.text: “Net divestment for the period” describes withdrawals without labeling them as a loss.

items.title: One fund state per row
items.text: A single status badge reduces competing signals in portfolio lists.

items.title: Six name fields
items.text: Captures the legal names used across Latin American identity documents.

items.title: Self-hosted Lucide icon font
items.text: Keeps the icon set local and available through a predictable class API.

items.title: AI-assisted, human-reviewed
items.text: Claude Code and Codex support implementation; review and CI remain the quality gate.

quality.title: Quality is part of the product.
quality.body: Automated checks protect the generated bundle and the customer-facing prototype, from source contracts to keyboard access and responsive layouts.
